summary: Chemung Financial Corporation filed an 8-K solely to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.34 per share, payable July 1, 2026, to shareholders of record June 17, 2026. No special-situation elements are present—it is a routine capital-allocation action. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, or other event category applicable. The filing is informational only, with no board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics. No risk-arb or regulatory angle to watch.
